result.summary: Found 1 major visual/content issue: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken/missing cover image instead of its restaurant photo. There is also a minor text-truncation issue.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under 'Popular right now' shows a broken/missing cover image (grey placeholder with a crossed-out picture icon) instead of the actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Provide a valid cover image asset for Tokumaru Ramen Bar and add a fallback/default image if an image fails to load so users never see the broken placeholder.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation best practices, such as an ellipsis with a tooltip/full title on tap, or adjust card widths to reveal more of the name.
